_comment: Ink 2026-11-09 proposed data for TUTORIAL-1. Ship copies to res://data/tutorial/first_session_1936.json. Strings are final copy; triggers/complete are predicate ids implemented in TutorialGuideDomain.gd (pure, headless-testable).

steps.title: You lead Germany, 1936
steps.body: The map opens on Germany, your country. The game is paused. This short guide shows the basics. Skip it any time.

steps.title: Time is paused
steps.body: Nothing moves until you start the clock. Press Space to run time, and 1–4 to pick a speed. Watch the date change, then press Space again to pause.
steps.status: Waiting for you: run 1 day, then pause

steps.title: See the map another way
steps.body: Map modes recolour the map. Press F5 for supply or F6 for loyalty. F1 brings back the political map.
steps.status: Waiting for you: switch map mode
steps.done_title: F1 brings you back to Political

steps.title: Look at a province
steps.body: Click any province on the map. The inspector on the left shows its owner, factories and terrain. Close shuts it.
steps.status: Waiting for you: click a province

steps.title: Meet your divisions
steps.body: The counters on the map are your divisions. Click one to open its card. Fill% is equipment on hand, not strength.
steps.status: Waiting for you: open a division card

steps.title: Wars need a reason first
steps.body: You are at peace. To attack Poland you first justify a war. Press Justify war on Poland in the inspector. Diplomacy (Dipl) has the same button.
steps.body_no_inspector: You are at peace. To attack Poland you first justify a war. Click a Polish province to open the inspector.
steps.status: Waiting for you: start a justification

steps.title: Let the claim build
steps.body: Justifying takes 14 days. Unpause and let the clock run. The guide pauses the game for you when it is ready.
steps._pause_note: Uses the clock owner public pause()/is_paused() from AUTOSAVE-1 (or added by TUTORIAL-1 if it lands first). No private calls.

steps.title: Your claim is ready
steps.body: The guide paused the game. Press Declare war on Poland. Declaring does not move troops. Your divisions wait for your orders.
steps.done_body: Good. Declaring changes nothing on the map by itself. Your divisions wait for your orders.

steps.title: Move an army
steps.body: Click a division, press March…, then click your own land next to Poland. Unpause so it walks. Esc cancels.
steps.status: Waiting for you: give a march order

steps.title: Start a fight
steps.body: Your division is next to Polish troops. Press Open fight, or Ctrl+click the enemy province. Then pick a stance: Press, Hold or Withdraw.
steps.status: Waiting for you: open a battle

steps.title: Save your game
steps.body: Press Ctrl+S to quicksave now. Ctrl+Shift+S opens the save list. Ctrl+L loads your quicksave.

target.note: SaveButton/LoadButton nodes exist in TopInfoBar.tscn MenuContainer but the live bar shows a single Menu

steps.title: How the campaign ends
steps.body: If Germany capitulates, it is Defeat. Beat two major powers for Victory. Otherwise it ends on 1 January 1949: the top industry is Ascendant, the rest are Eclipsed.
